caption: The drawing shows a folded rectangular textile, such as a quilt or coverlet, with a predominantly light beige or off-white background. The textile features a repeating floral pattern with symmetrical green stems and leaves, and pink flowers that have small yellow centers or tips. A green wavy border with green leaves and small pink flowers runs parallel to the edges of the textile. The floral motifs are arranged in a circular pattern towards the center, and the fabric appears to have soft folds and creases, suggesting a three-dimensional form. The composition includes shading to give volume to the folds, and the entire textile is bordered by a double-outline of green.
title: Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
